_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Simulation Paper. UAV-aided Retroreflective Optical ISAC (RO-ISAC). Uses Angle Diversity Transmitters (ADT) on UAVs and Corner Cube Reflector (CCR) on Target.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: UAV network with ADT, Target with CCR. Fig 2: ADT structure (center + inclined side LEDs). Fig 4: BER/RMSE vs SNR. Fig 5: BER/RMSE vs Height.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: UAV-based FSO ISAC. Sensing: Retroreflective (UAV->CCR->UAV) 3D positioning using TOA/ranging. Comm: Downlink UAV->Target. Waveform: OFDM.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: BER improvement with ADT (10 LEDs vs Baseline). Sensing: Positioning RMSE ~1.2 cm at 120 dB SNR (with 10 LEDs).
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Combines UAV mobility, Angle Diversity (ADT) for coverage/robustness, and Passive Retroreflection (CCR) for energy-efficient sensing.

bibliographic.title: UAV-Aided Flying Retroreflective Optical ISAC with Angle Diversity Transmitters
bibliographic.authors: Weiren Wang, Haochuan Wang, Zhihong Zeng, Cuiwei He, Chen Chen

application.scenario_description: Four UAVs with ADTs providing comms and positioning to a target with CCR.

key_contribution.key_contribution: UAV-aided RO-ISAC with Angle Diversity Transmitters (ADTs).
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Enhancing SNR and coverage for UAV-based optical ISAC.

transmitter.notes: Angle Diversity Transmitter (ADT): 1 Center + N Side LEDs. 64 subcarriers.

receiver.notes: PD at Target (Comm) and PD at UAV (Sensing/Reflection).

integration.notes: UAV Tx -> Target Rx (Comm). UAV Tx -> Target CCR -> UAV Rx (Sensing).

waveform.notes: OFDM used for both. Cross-correlation for sensing.

comm_metrics.notes: BER < 10^-4 at 110 dB SNR with 10-LED ADT.

sensing_metrics.notes: 6 cm ranging resolution. Positioning RMSE ~1.2 cm at 120 dB SNR.

tradeoff.notes: Lower UAV height improves sensing RMSE but has limited effect on BER.
